en.content:
In the reference image, use @ to specify the female lead as the sole identity reference, ensuring that her face shape, facial features, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing style, and temperament remain consistent throughout.  
In the Seedance 2.0 prompt, add the overall style: realistic iPhone to achieve a more realistic mobile photography texture.
